items.description:
Create a polished first landing page for this organization using the verified onboarding context below.

Primary conversion goal: "title": "Offer Brief",

Core page idea: turn the strongest offer and audience pain into a concrete, specific promise. The visitor should immediately understand who this is for, what outcome they get, why the company is credible, and what to do next.

Recommended structure: concise hero with one primary CTA, problem-to-outcome section, 3-5 value props, proof or credib
